---
title: "Quantum Annealing with D-Wave"
---

This module introduces quantum annealing and the D-Wave Ocean SDK through a set of tutorials and demonstrations. The two main workshop notebooks provide hands-on examples using both D-Wave's quantum hardware and a local simulated annealer.

## Main Tutorials

### D-Wave Quantum Annealing Demonstration

Learn how optimization problems can be formulated as QUBOs and solved using D-Wave's Ocean SDK and a D-Wave quantum processing unit through Leap Quantum Cloud.

[Start D-Wave Quantum Annealing Demonstration →](<D-wave SDK Demonstration Quantum Annealing.ipynb>)

### Local Simulated Annealing Demonstration

Work through the same general optimization workflow locally using simulated annealing. This notebook does not require access to D-Wave Leap and will allow you to experiment with the examples on your own computer.

[Start Local Simulated Annealing Demonstration →](<D-wave SDK Demonstration Quantum Annealing.ipynb>)

## Background and Additional Material

### Quantum Annealing Explained

Learn more about how quantum annealing works, including the connection between optimization problems, Ising models, and the physical operation of a quantum annealer.

[Learn How Quantum Annealing Works →](<Quantum Annealing Explained.ipynb>)

### Additional D-Wave Topics

Explore additional D-Wave Ocean features, optimization problems, and examples beyond those covered in the main workshop.

[Explore Additional D-Wave Topics →](<Additional D-wave Topics.ipynb>)

## About

These materials were developed for the Quantum Science, Technology, and Engineering Workshop at Purdue University.
